games.name: Vault Rush
games.tagline: Grab the cash · Raid your rivals · Lock your vault
games.about: A fast heist strategy game. Every round cash boxes drop into the vault and everyone secretly picks one move: claim a box, raid a rival, or lock their cash in the safe. All moves happen at once.
howTo: 📦 Tap a box to claim its cash. Same box? The cash is split.
⚔️ Tap a rival to steal 95% of their unsecured cash.
🔒 Tap your safe to bank your cash and block every raid on you.
🏆 Most total cash after the Final Heist wins.

games.name: Chor Police Dakat Babu
games.tagline: The classic chit game, now on everyone's phone
games.about: No paper chits needed. Everyone gets a secret chit, the Babu decides who the Police must hunt, and the Police has one guess to catch the Chor or the Dakat.
howTo: 🎴 Everyone gets a secret chit: Babu, Police, Dakat or Chor.
👑 The Babu picks who the Police must find: Chor or Dakat.
👮 The Police guesses. Right guess = 900 points, wrong = 0.
🔢 Points add up round after round. Highest total wins.
games.time: Play as long as you like

games.name: Ram Shaayam Jadu Madhu
games.tagline: Pass the cards. Collect four of a kind. Shout first!
games.about: The real-time card-passing game. Everyone holds four cards and passes one to the next player each turn. The first to hold four cards with the same name wins the round.
howTo: 🃏 Everyone gets 4 random cards: Ram, Shaayam, Jadu, Madhu.
👉 On your turn, pass one card to the next player.
🔒 You can't pass the card you just received.
⭐ First to hold 4 of the same name wins the round.

games.name: The Lost Frontier
games.tagline: Cut off in the wild. Explore together and light the beacon!
games.about: A real-time wilderness adventure on one big open map. Everyone walks around at the same time, carries things, pushes heavy stones together and notices different clues. Cross the ravine, find the parts and light the beacon before dusk.
howTo: 🕹️ Walk around the open map together (drag on the left side, or use WASD).
🔘 The big button picks up, drops, places and fits things. Hold Push to shove heavy stones.
👁 Your Sight shows hints only you can see. Walk to one, then tap Share to mark it for everyone.
🌉 Cross the ravine by fixing the bridge or by moving the boulder together.
🔥 Fit the gear and fuel, hold both plates, and light the beacon before dusk.
